entities.summary: William David Christian is an American former ice hockey player. As a member of the United States hockey team, he won the gold medal at the 1960 Winter Olympics. He was inducted into the United States Hockey Hall of Fame in 1984, and the International Ice Hockey Federation Hall of Fame in 1998.
